_example: INERT EXAMPLE — NOT installed by setup. `setup-claude-settings.mjs` reads ONLY settings.recommended.json, so this file is never merged into any consumer repo. Copy the PreToolUse group below into your OWN .claude/settings.json by hand if you want RTK output compression. RTK is lossy (see references/external-tools.md) — opt in deliberately, per repo.
_critical: The exclude glob MUST keep `npm run brain:*` OUT of rewriting. brain:pack / brain:search / brain:ask emit the packed context the brain exists to provide; lossy-compressing it corrupts the very payload downstream agents read. Never drop the brain:* exclusion.
_coexistence: This Bash PreToolUse group runs ALONGSIDE the brain's own Bash PreToolUse nudge (brain-route-tool.mjs --surface bash, from #17) — Claude Code runs every matching hook. Keep RTK from rewriting the brain's own `brain:*` invocations so the nudge matchers still see the real command.
